original_provenance.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: production architectural background plate for an adult agricultural university web application.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved direction board; use its interior architectural photography and materials as the exact visual language. Image 2 is the newly regenerated clean campus, the same physical place.
World invariants: the same Latin American foothill agricultural research campus, oxidized copper roof outside, silver weathered wood, light timber inside, mineral concrete, blue-grey metal glazing, broad green foothill ridge and test crops outside. Same cool blue-grey and grey-green light with natural rust and pale wood, soft overcast morning with pockets of sun. Cinematic documentary architectural photograph with tactile materials, credible real proportions and mature functional furnishing, no resort styling.
Output: a SINGLE full-bleed landscape architectural photograph, 16:10 aspect ratio, ideally 2560 x 1600 pixels. No board, no screenshot.
Primary request: Inside the auditorium pavilion that is center-right in the approved clean campus. A modest real university field-station lecture auditorium, the same copper gabled roof, exposed timber sloping structure, light wood wall panels, mineral concrete and blue-grey glazed framing.
Composition/framing: from the rear at adult eye height toward a low simple pale wood stage in the front center. Approximately forty empty understated grey/wood chairs in 5 short rows at lower left and lower right, a clear center aisle leading to the stage. A large completely blank matte dark charcoal projection screen with straight horizontal/vertical edges on the front wall at center, about x28%–74%, y20%–61%, facing camera, large enough for later live content. Small unbranded lectern at the left edge of the stage. Floor concrete, exposed timber ceiling, large blue-grey framed windows on the left looking to the same patchwork green ridge and native garden, daylight balanced with restrained ceiling lights. The building is the visibly taller gabled copper pavilion from the campus. Adult academic architecture, no concert rig, no theatrical velvet curtains, no grand conference hall, no crowd, no display content.
Hard constraints: zero people, zero branding, zero text, zero letters/numbers/symbols on objects or walls, no signs, no labels, no logos, no posters with writing, no UI, buttons, icons, panels, overlays, watermarks or borders. Blank physical screens where specified. Do not render any website content. Every square inch must be a coherent real architectural space.

use: Restored first prototype interior, copied without editing.
